name: ScrapeGraphAI
description: Python library that builds LLM-driven scraping pipelines from a prompt describing the data you want from a site or document.
whatItDoes: Extracts structured information from websites and local documents without hand-written parsing rules. Data engineers and developers describe the target fields and get JSON back.
howItWorks: Ready-made graph pipelines fetch pages with a headless browser, split and filter the content and pass it to a model that produces the requested structure. Different graph types cover single pages, searches and multi-page crawls.

requirements.name: LLM provider key or local model

models: OpenAI, Groq, Azure, Gemini, Ollama and others
